en: Codex reset credits can now be used while a task is running. Redemption uses a separate connection and leaves the running task and its output stream intact.

Manual account-specific confirmation, duplicate-request protection and retry idempotency remain in place. Finished turns are not automatically restarted. Concurrency and interface checks use simulated redemption without spending real credits.
zh: Codex 重置卡现在可在任务运行期间手动使用；重置通过独立连接执行，保留正在运行的任务及其输出连接。
保留针对所选账号的手动确认、防重复请求与失败重试幂等保护。已结束的轮次不会自动重启；并发和界面检查使用模拟重置，未消耗真实重置卡。
